title: Limited Companies Adventure
welcome_lead: Step up to the limited company — bigger, safer, more rules. 🏢
meta_desc: Types of Business Adventure 2 — KS3 Business Studies on private and public limited companies.
final_note: You learned what a limited company is, how Ltd and plc differ, and what shares are.

concepts.def: A business that is its own legal person
Owners only risk what they invest
A person who owns part of a company
Public limited company on stock market
A share of profit paid to shareholders

walkthroughs.body_html:
A limited company is its own legal person.

Owners (shareholders) have limited liability — they only risk the money they put in. Their house is safe. 🏠

Ltd — Private. Shares only sold to friends and family. Most small companies.

plc — Public. Shares trade on the stock market. Examples: Tesco plc, BP plc.

A share is one slice of the company.

If the company makes profit, shareholders may get a dividend — a cash payment per share.

More rules: companies must file accounts with the government. 📑
